name: @instafy/codex-adapter
description: Instafy wrapper scripts for the upstream codex/ submodule.

scripts.codex:status: git -C ../.. submodule status codex && git -C ../../codex rev-parse HEAD
scripts.codex:update: git -C ../.. submodule sync -- codex && git -C ../.. submodule update --init --recursive --remote codex
